summary: This note describes the 2018 American Christian drama film I Can Only Imagine, directed by the Erwin Brothers and written by Alex Cramer, Jon Erwin and Brent McCorkle. The film is based on the story behind the MercyMe song of the same name, described as the best-selling Christian single of all time. J. Michael Finley plays Bart Millard, the song's writer, opposite Dennis Quaid as his father, with Madeline Carroll, Priscilla Shirer, Cloris Leachman and Trace Adkins also starring. The text is duplicated in the source.

key_facts: I Can Only Imagine is a 2018 American Christian drama film.
The film was directed by the Erwin Brothers.
The film was written by Alex Cramer, Jon Erwin and Brent McCorkle.
The film is based on the story behind the MercyMe song of the same name.
The MercyMe song I Can Only Imagine is described as the best-selling Christian single of all time.
J. Michael Finley stars as Bart Millard, the lead singer who wrote the song.
Bart Millard wrote the song about his relationship with his father.
Dennis Quaid plays Bart Millard's father.
Madeline Carroll also stars in the film.
Priscilla Shirer also stars in the film.
Cloris Leachman also stars in the film.
Trace Adkins also stars in the film.
